messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
當你把球以 5 m/s 的初速直向上拋出時，球在空中會受到重力的影響。  
在忽略空氣阻力的理想情況下，重力提供了一個恆定的向下加速度，大小約為  

\[
g \approx 9.8 \text{ m/s}^2
\]

（符號取決於座標系：若上方為正方向，則加速度為 \(-9.8\) m/s²；若下方為正方向，則為 \(+9.8\) m/s²）。  

因此，球在上升過程中的加速度始終是這個常數值，而不是隨時間變化。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "If a ball is thrown straight up at 5 m/s, what acceleration will it reach?" Actually they ask: "它將達到什麼加速度" which means "what acceleration will it reach". That seems odd: acceleration is constant due to gravity (approx -9.8 m/s^2). They might mean maximum height? But they specifically ask acceleration. So answer: acceleration due to gravity downward ~ -9.8 m/s^2. Provide explanation. No function call needed.
